description: Credit a USDC top-up to your review credits: first send USDC from a wallet verified to your DID to the chain's Synmerco treasury (get_crypto_health shows it as commerce.treasury), then pass the transaction hash here. Credited once, after enough confirmations. Requires SYNMERCO_API_KEY.

chain.description: Chain the USDC was sent on

txHash.description: Transaction hash of the USDC transfer
